    • homeLift

      public edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command homeLift()
      Returns a Command that homes the lift by slowly driving it upward toward the upper hard stop, detecting the stall via stator current, and zeroing the encoder when the stall is confirmed.

      The lift motor drives at LIFT_HOMING_SPEED (positive = raise) until the stator current exceeds LIFT_HOMING_STALL_AMPS for at least LIFT_HOMING_STALL_DURATION_S continuous seconds, indicating the mechanism has hit the hard stop. The encoder is then zeroed so that 0 is the stowed position and Constants.IntakeSubsystemConstants.LIFT_LOWERED_ROTATIONS is the fully-lowered position.

      Returns:
      the homing command
